answer_1.quote: We trained a Causal-Aware Empathetic Response model, CAER, using our ECC dataset... to generate subsequent empathetic responses.

answer_2.quote: automatic evaluation indicators use PPL, Dist-1/2 and Blue-1/2

answer_3.quote: To confirm the quality of labels, we conduct an automatic evaluation of the rationality using GPT-4.0... with a scoring system out of 5... we request LLMs provide reasoning during the evaluation process.

answer_4.quote: We invited three human evaluators... to conduct a manual evaluation of 100 randomly selected dialogues from the ECC dataset. Four evaluation criteria were established: Affective, Relevance, Consistency, and Naturalness, along with an Overall score.
answer_4.guideline: Establish criteria for manual evaluation: Affective, Relevance, Consistency, Naturalness, and Overall effectiveness.
